skill.summary: MCP (Model Context Protocol) Integration Guide - How to build and launch MCP-based tools and integrations.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of mcp-integration-guide.

- Provides an overview of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.
- Includes instructions for building MCP servers and clients.
- Covers integration patterns, best practices, and launching MCP tools.
- Lists free resources and official MCP documentation.
- Highlights premium resources for marketing and launching products.
- Offers expert consulting services for MCP tool launches.
